name: AWS Cloud Security & IAM Posture
description: Auditing AWS cloud environments, least-privilege IAM policy design, and security posture monitoring.
best_practices: Least-privilege IAM: Design tightly scoped IAM policies with explicit Actions, Resources, and Condition keys.
Enforcement of MFA: Require Multi-Factor Authentication on all interactive console logins and privileged assume-role policies.
KMS key rotation: Use AWS Key Management Service Customer Managed Keys with annual automatic key rotation enabled.
Encryption everywhere: Enforce encryption at rest for S3 buckets, EBS volumes, and RDS instances, alongside TLS in transit.
Private subnet isolation: Deploy computing workloads in private subnets with NAT gateways, avoiding public IPv4 addresses.
